title: Build a binary search tree
description: Implement traversals(values). Insert integers in order into a BST; ignore duplicates. Return [preorder, inorder, postorder], each a list. Use nodes and recursive traversal, not sorting. Empty input returns three empty lists.
hints: A node can contain a value and references to its two children.
Pre-order visits before children; in-order between them; post-order after them.
